dedupe_keys.name: western australia mineral exploration drillholes open file

description: This dataset holds historic mineral exploration drillholes that mining companies submitted under the Western Australian Mining Act 1978, released as open file after a standard five-year confidentiality period. At minimum it contains drillhole collars validated against tenement outlines, and depending on what companies supplied it adds assays, geology and downhole surveys. It is published by the Department of Energy, Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety (DEMIRS) of Western Australia through the Data WA catalogue. Coverage is the state of Western Australia; the data are updated weekly, most recently on 26 September 2026. Files come as file geodatabase, shapefile and MapInfo TAB downloads, with WFS, WMS and ArcGIS map services, free and without login under a CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: content depends on company submissions of varying quality and age, and the catalogue entry does not give record counts. For simulation it provides subsurface points for mineral supply studies, geological models and screening of ground conditions for mines, roads and rail in the state. It is related to the Global Drillhole Database record in this catalogue, which draws most of its records from this source.
